relevanceToRedundancyRatio.description:
The relevanceToRedundancyRatio is used for filtering passages out, trade-off "relevance to query" vs "marginally relevant information"
(AKA lambda_mult in langchain). The range for this parameter is between 0 and 1.
{@link https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/blob/98c8516ef146714b71be6650cc745d262431afaf/libs/langchain/langchain/vectorstores/utils.py#L23-L54}
When this param is 0, it's putting all it's weight on the passage-to-passage redundancy penalty, and
when the param is 1 it's completely ignoring the redundancy penalty in the re-scoring of passages, essentially neutering any MMR capabilities

fetchPassagesMultiplier.description: MMR fetch passages multiplier, default is 2.0
